title: Exclude fixed-bank BIT productive helper splits (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On the retained #7001/#6726 36-copy BIT word, every fixed-bank rank-preserving two-way productive split with its original public pivot fails the paired prefix and suffix support test. The census exhausts 434 pivots, 9,116 changed chart banks and 9,314 boundary-group contexts. Its whole-word compatible saving upper is exactly zero against a shortfall of about 60.10389921914735 raw units at κ = 0.0040075385047236.

## Task and overlap

Changed productive inventory scope on canonical e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Fixed literal paid children, caller, scalar order and ownership lifetimes. The original public pivot remains in its original slot at a strictly nested intermediate chart. The scope grants arbitrary coframed basis and independent endpoint mixing within its existing helper group. #5679 uses related paired support on an older G20 word. #7271–#7273 cover distinct retained-word donor and terminal ingress mechanisms. The strongest independently reproduced comparable κ remains 0.003645669928698 on exact #7277 head ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea.

## Validation

From a clean checkout using CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-fixed-bank-split-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-fixed-bank-split-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

Independent reverse replay reconstructs all 62,474 lineage edges, every support context and the full signed invoice. The omitted paid MOVE and support-contamination controls fail as expected. Committed source history, navigation and clean Git-free export passed. The package authenticates the literal inputs by stable path and rejects duplicate source keys. The branch inherits the two exact #7257 hosted prerequisites. No new supplier or physical construction was claimed.

## Credit and open next questions

#5599/#5679 provide the cocharted split identity. #6726/#7001 provide the exact BIT word and signed caller, #7294 provides the authenticated price and replay inputs, #7271–#7273 cover adjacent mechanisms, and #7277 supplies the complete comparator. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

A different pivot, changed chart or changed paid schedule needs a fresh support and whole-word price bound before any build.
